finding: Foundation Foods and Branded datasets have an April 2026 downloadable release; FNDDS is 2021–2023 released October 2024.
decision: Pin authoritative ingredient ingestion to Foundation 2026-04; use SR Legacy only when no better current record exists.
impact_on_IFKB: Prevents silent drift and keeps source release reproducible.

finding: Foundation values are analytically derived; FNDDS is compiled; Branded values are label-derived; SR Legacy is historical.
decision: Store data_type and derivation separately and assign different evidence ceilings.
impact_on_IFKB: Stops label data and laboratory data being treated as equivalent.

finding: Food matching should be stepwise, select the highest-quality match and document differences; calories must not be copied alone.
decision: Use match quality A/B/C/D/U and block calorie-only imports.
impact_on_IFKB: Improves scientific traceability and prevents misleading exactness.

finding: Energy should be calculated within the receiving database; proximate sums have preferred and acceptable bands.
decision: Add formula-driven energy delta and proximate-sum rules.
impact_on_IFKB: Detects unit errors, column shifts and incomplete profiles.

finding: Several generic rows are plausible, while others contain values inconsistent with the stated food description.
decision: Use only in quarantine/candidate discovery; never promote without authoritative verification.
impact_on_IFKB: Prevents convenience datasets contaminating the scientific master.
